'''Jakker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he served as a bodyguard to newly-appointed [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Zhorrid]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. During a meeting with [[Cipher Nine]], Zhorrid ordered Jakker and other bodyguards to kill her visitor, but they failed and were all killed instead.<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Jakker appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on Korriban.
